title: Phase 36 Automated Test Suite & Command QA Results

test_cases.description: Verifies all valid state transitions defined in ALLOWED_STATE_TRANSITIONS succeed deterministically
Ensures invalid transitions (e.g., PLANNING to COMPLETED, PAUSED to PLANNING) are rejected with INVALID_STATE
Validates full pause/resume cycle: RUNNING -> PAUSED -> RUNNING with version incrementing
Guarantees that invoking PAUSE on an already PAUSED mission fails with INVALID_STATE
Ensures RESUME on a RUNNING or PLANNING mission is rejected
Validates that CANCEL transitions to CANCELLED and that CANCELLED is an immutable terminal state
Validates APPROVE command on PENDING_APPROVAL task, transitioning it to DONE and unblocking pipeline
Validates REJECT decision on PENDING_APPROVAL task, transitioning to FAILED/REJECTED
Ensures human approval commands fail with INVALID_STATE if target task is not PENDING_APPROVAL
Confirms priority modifications (CRITICAL, HIGH, NORMAL, LOW) take effect without violating DAG structure
Verifies valid swaps succeed and invalid swaps violating causal dependencies return CONFLICT
Ensures commands presenting an outdated expected_mission_version return STALE status
Ensures repeated commands with identical idempotency_key return cached results without re-execution
Confirms a burst of 10 identical commands produces exactly 1 execution and 9 cache hits
Proves malicious commands containing exploit patterns are blocked by Sentinel with SECURITY_BLOCK
Verifies end-to-end WebSocket message routing, payload dispatch, and response generation
